newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends firm as dollar consolidates.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends firm as dollar consolidates.

text.p: 1545 GMT - The Swiss franc ended firmer against the dollar and mark as the U.S. unit consolidated after recent gains, closing in Zurich below 1.47 Swiss francs.
Aurel David, technical analyst at Bank Julius Baer, described activity as "just range trading" within a correction. The dollar's drop against the mark also weakened it versus the Swiss franc.
The 1.68-mark level is seen as dollar support. David believes there is scope for the dollar to resume recent gains.
"I wouldn't try the short side too many times," David said.
But if dollar/Swiss dips below 1.4620 francs, the dollar upmove may be endangered. "Then 1.4450 could be tested," he said.
* The dollar ended at 1.4670/4680 Swiss francs versus 1.4804/4814 francs at Thursday's close. The dollar began trade Friday at 1.4760/4770 Swiss francs.
* The mark ended at 87.12/14 Swiss centimes versus 87.74/76 at Thursday's close. The mark began at 87.58/60 centimes.
